tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (ground). Generous, quiet ground so the one accent can carry the page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, input backgrounds on top of paper. Separate from paper with a line border, never a shadow.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, the logo glyph, primary icons. On paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta. Passes 4.5:1 on paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers (1px). Decorative only: never for text or as the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls: meets 3:1 against paper and surface.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: THE accent: the stop dot in the logo, primary button fill, active stop marker. One signal element per view. Put ink (on-signal), never white, on it.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signal fills (about 6:1). White on signal fails contrast: never use it for text.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text on paper and surface. signal itself is too light for text on paper.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Campaign accent (Lime Night): launch posts, Product Hunt, talk key visuals. Only on an ink (#141414) ground, never on the same screen as signal, never in product UI.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lime fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour (2px outline, 2px offset).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines on banger.page. Latin only: Japanese falls back to Noto Sans JP.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: AIと話して、HTMLで作って、PDFでも配れる。

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 停止点ごとに書き出すので、どこにでも共有できます。
styles.usage: Running text. Japanese needs the generous leading.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta, credit line, footnotes. Use ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code samples, CLI commands, tag names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between related items in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, the logo's outer bowl corner at 64px.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, embedded slide frames.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon and favicon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: status badges, segmented controls.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Card and divider lines (line token).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, with 2px offset.
